atoms.exact_source_text: Before the Colony possesses a Workshop, Builder has one early-game exemption and may conduct one Project at a time without an available Workshop.
atoms.normalized_claim: Before the Colony possesses a Workshop, Builder has one early-game exemption and may conduct one Project at a time without an available Workshop.

atoms.exact_source_text: Building the first Workshop ends that exemption.
atoms.normalized_claim: Building the first Workshop ends the Builder's early-game exemption allowing one Project at a time without an available Workshop.

atoms.exact_source_text: Builder concurrency thereafter follows the same Place-based rule as every other Role: each available Workshop may support one Builder Project at a time.
atoms.normalized_claim: Builder concurrency thereafter follows the same Place-based rule as every other Role: each available Workshop may support one Builder Project at a time.

atoms.exact_source_text: Additional Citizens assigned to a Role may contribute Citizen-Days to an eligible entry, preserve ordinary Role coverage, or remain fully on ordinary Practice.
atoms.normalized_claim: Additional Citizens assigned to a Role may contribute Citizen-Days to an eligible entry, preserve ordinary Role coverage, or remain fully on ordinary Practice.

atoms.exact_source_text: Actual progress remains limited by available named-Citizen Capacity and the loss of ordinary coverage
atoms.normalized_claim: Actual progress remains limited by available named-Citizen Capacity and the loss of ordinary coverage.

atoms.exact_source_text: there is no abstract Colony-wide queue-slot statistic.
atoms.normalized_claim: There is no abstract Colony-wide queue-slot statistic.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Provisioning** is the shared passive-transformation system through which available Role Capacity converts existing stocks into prepared stocks or consumable items.
atoms.normalized_claim: Provisioning is the shared passive-transformation system through which available Role Capacity converts existing stocks into prepared stocks or consumable items.

atoms.exact_source_text: Provisioning is routine, conditional, ongoing, and player-directed.
atoms.normalized_claim: Provisioning is routine, conditional, ongoing, and player-directed.

atoms.exact_source_text: It never creates resources from nothing.
atoms.normalized_claim: Provisioning never creates resources from nothing.

atoms.exact_source_text: Perishable Sustenance → Durable Sustenance
atoms.normalized_claim: Caretakers may transform Perishable Sustenance into Durable Sustenance.

atoms.exact_source_text: This represents drying, protecting, sorting, wrapping, caching, and other culturally appropriate preservation.
atoms.normalized_claim: The transformation of Perishable Sustenance into Durable Sustenance represents drying, protecting, sorting, wrapping, caching, and other culturally appropriate preservation.

atoms.exact_source_text: Preservation is limited by available Perishable Sustenance, Caretaker Capacity not committed to a Project, suitable Stores or household Places, known preservation Practices, and player instructions.
atoms.normalized_claim: Preservation is limited by available Perishable Sustenance, Caretaker Capacity not committed to a Project, suitable Stores or household Places, known preservation Practices, and player instructions.

atoms.exact_source_text: Crafters may transform Sustenance and Scrap into Supply items according to known class recipes.
atoms.normalized_claim: Crafters may transform Sustenance and Scrap into Supply items according to known class recipes.

atoms.exact_source_text: Supply Preparation is limited by available ingredients, Crafter Capacity not committed to a Tool or Project, a suitable Workshop or preparation Place, known Supply recipes, and player-set targets and reserves.
atoms.normalized_claim: Supply Preparation is limited by available ingredients, Crafter Capacity not committed to a Tool or Project, a suitable Workshop or preparation Place, known Supply recipes, and player-set targets and reserves.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Crafter servicing the Project Queue provides no Provisioning with that committed civic share.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Crafter servicing the Project Queue provides no Provisioning with that committed civic share.

atoms.exact_source_text: Provisioning does not automatically consume every eligible resource.
atoms.normalized_claim: Provisioning does not automatically consume every eligible resource.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Prepare:** operate while inputs and Capacity permit
atoms.normalized_claim: Each Provisioning process may be set to Prepare, operating while inputs and Capacity permit.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Hold:** suspend transformation while retaining the Role assignment
atoms.normalized_claim: Each Provisioning process may be set to Hold, suspending transformation while retaining the Role assignment.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Unavailable:** lacking the required Capacity, Place, material, or Practice.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each Provisioning process may be Unavailable, lacking the required Capacity, Place, material, or Practice.

atoms.exact_source_text: Holding Provisioning does not make the Citizen idle.
atoms.normalized_claim: Holding Provisioning does not make the Citizen idle.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Role continues its broader Standing Practice but does not convert stock.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Role continues its broader Standing Practice but does not convert stock.
